hooks.visual_action: A dense task list folds into one bounded decision card.

script.voiceover: Count the obligations that can end the game.
Then choose one reversible move inside the bound.

hooks.cta: Name the bound before the task.

hooks.visual_action: A glowing path stops at three labeled boundary stones.

script.voiceover: Not the missed post. The obligation you cannot absorb.
A viable system sees the boundary before it moves.

hooks.visual_action: Four ledger cards align into a visible sequence.

script.voiceover: Keep the evidence, authority, action, and result together.
Then the next cycle starts from truth, not theatre.

hooks.visual_action: A ladder dissolves into concentric seasonal rings and a branching path.

script.voiceover: A venture can narrow, rest, branch, or begin again.
The purpose continues; the instrument can end.

hooks.cta: Release one instrument that no longer serves.
